title: Copula-based hierarchical risk parity: modelling nonlinear dependence structures for portfolio allocation
title_zh: 基于Copula的分层风险平价：为投资组合配置建模非线性相依结构
title_primary: 基于Copula的分层风险平价：为投资组合配置建模非线性相依结构
title_secondary: Copula-based hierarchical risk parity: modelling nonlinear dependence structures for portfolio allocation
authors: Changhui Choi, So Eun Choi, Bong-Gyu Jang, Minju Kim, Ki Hwan Koo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper proposes a Hierarchical Archimedean Copula Risk Parity (HAC-RP) framework that extends the conventional Hierarchical Risk Parity (HRP) approach by incorporating nonlinear and asymmetric dependence through hierarchical Archimedean copulas. Three copula specifications – Gumbel, Clayton, and a multi-generator HAC – are considered within the HRP allocation framework. The proposed method is evaluated using monthly U.S. sector ETF data and compared with conventional HRP, a Ledoit – Wolf global minimum-variance portfolio, and an equal-weight benchmark. Empirical results show that the proposed HAC portfolios provide competitive risk-adjusted performance while maintaining favourable diversification and turnover characteristics. Among the proposed specifications, the multi-generator HAC exhibits the strongest overall performance. These findings suggest that hierarchical copulas provide a practical extension of the conventional HRP framework for portfolio construction. KEYWORDS: Risk parity stock volatility Archimedean copula portfolio selection portfolio performance JEL CLASSIFICATION: G11 C46 C58 Acknowledgements This article develops and substantially extends research originally presented in Minju Kim’s master’s thesis, “A Hierarchical Asset Allocation Capturing the Smile Phenomenon of Cross-Sectional Market Volatility Using an Archimedean Copula,” submitted to Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH) in 2023.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种分层阿基米德Copula风险平价（HAC-RP）框架，通过引入分层阿基米德Copula来捕捉非线性及非对称依赖性，从而扩展了传统的分层风险平价（HRP）方法。在HRP配置框架内，考虑了三种Copula设定——Gumbel、Clayton以及多生成元HAC。所提方法利用美国行业ETF月度数据进行评估，并与传统HRP、Ledoit-Wolf全局最小方差组合及等权重基准进行比较。实证结果表明，所提出的HAC组合在保持良好分散化和换手率特性的同时，提供了具有竞争力的风险调整后表现。在所提设定中，多生成元HAC展现出最强的整体表现。这些发现表明，分层Copula为传统HRP框架在组合构建中提供了一种实用的扩展。关键词：风险平价 股票波动率 阿基米德Copula 组合选择 组合表现 JEL分类：G11 C46 C58 致谢 本文发展并大幅扩展了最初发表于金敏珠（Minju Kim）硕士论文中的研究，该论文题为“利用阿基米德Copula捕捉横截面市场波动微笑现象的分层资产配置”，于2023年提交至浦项科技大学（POSTECH）。

title: The Environmental Costs of Sanctions: Flaring and Venting in Venezuela
title_zh: 制裁的环境成本：委内瑞拉的天然气燃烧与排放
title_primary: 制裁的环境成本：委内瑞拉的天然气燃烧与排放
title_secondary: The Environmental Costs of Sanctions: Flaring and Venting in Venezuela
authors: Michele Fioretti, Kavanaugh FitzPatrick, Alessandro Iaria
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Economic sanctions on oil-producing autocracies change not only the quantity of oil but also how it is produced. Combining field-level production data with satellite measurements of gas flaring and atmospheric methane across six Latin American countries from 2012 to 2024, we study the U.S. sanctions on Venezuela. Per-barrel gas flaring in Venezuela rose about two-and-a-half-fold even as production fell by two-thirds, a pattern no unsanctioned neighbor shows, so environmental damage under sanctions is about two and a half times what a proportional decline in output would predict. Three channels generate this gap: the exit of small, dirty fields (composition) is more than offset by surviving fields running their infrastructure past design capacity (strain) and cutting their operating budgets (maintenance). We identify strain from the response of satellite-measured methane to the world price of naphtha, the imported diluent Venezuela's extra-heavy crude requires, and maintenance from a November 2022 U.S. Treasury license that allowed only Chevron to resume operations at its Venezuelan fields. A similar pattern of rising per-barrel emissions despite falling output appears under the sanctions on Iran (after 2018).
abstract_zh: 对产油独裁国家的经济制裁不仅改变了石油产量，更改变了石油生产方式。通过结合2012至2024年间六个拉丁美洲国家的油田级生产数据与卫星测量的天然气燃烧及大气甲烷浓度，我们研究了美国对委内瑞拉的制裁。在委内瑞拉石油产量下降三分之二的同时，每桶石油的天然气燃烧量却增加了约2.5倍——这一模式在未受制裁的邻国中并未出现。因此，制裁造成的环境损害约为按产量比例下降所预测值的2.5倍。三个渠道导致了这一差距：小型污染油田的退出（构成效应）被幸存油田超设计产能运行基础设施（超负荷效应）和削减运营预算（维护效应）所抵消。我们通过卫星测量的甲烷对石脑油（委内瑞拉超重质原油所需的进口稀释剂）国际价格的响应识别出超负荷效应，并通过2022年11月美国财政部仅允许雪佛龙恢复其委内瑞拉油田运营的许可证识别出维护效应。在针对伊朗的制裁（2018年后）中，同样出现了产量下降但每桶排放量上升的类似模式。

title: Vertical Integration and Cream Skimming of Profitable Referrals: The Case of Hospital-Owned Skilled Nursing Facilities
title_zh: 纵向整合与盈利转诊的“撇脂”行为：以医院自营专业护理机构为例
title_primary: 纵向整合与盈利转诊的“撇脂”行为：以医院自营专业护理机构为例
title_secondary: Vertical Integration and Cream Skimming of Profitable Referrals: The Case of Hospital-Owned Skilled Nursing Facilities
authors: David Cutler, Leemore Dafny, David C. Grabowski, Steven Lee, Christopher Ody
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine whether vertical integration of hospitals and skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) could lessen competition by foreclosing rival SNFs’ access to lucrative referrals. We find that it could: Among integrated providers, a 1 percent increase in SNF reimbursement for a given patient discharged from the upstream hospital increases the self-referral rate to the hospital’s downstream SNF(s) by 1.8 percent. We find no evidence of offsetting benefits for patients and payers: These increased self-referrals have an imprecisely estimated zero effect on patient outcomes and Medicare spending. (JEL G34, I11, I13, J14, L14, L22)
abstract_zh: 本文考察了医院与专业护理机构（SNFs）的纵向整合是否可能通过阻断竞争性SNFs获取高利润转诊渠道而削弱市场竞争。研究发现确实存在此效应：在整合型医疗服务提供者中，上游医院出院患者的SNF报销比例每增加1%，该医院向下游自有SNF的自我转诊率将提升1.8%。未发现对患者及支付方存在补偿性收益的证据：这些增加的自我转诊对患者预后及医保支出的影响呈现不精确的零效应。（JEL分类号：G34, I11, I13, J14, L14, L22）

title: Quand les distinctions de la Légion d’honneur française font fluctuer les cours boursiers : un signal du marché indiquant l’accès aux cercles politiques
title_zh: 法国荣誉军团勋章授勋引发股价波动：市场信号揭示政治圈层准入
title_primary: 法国荣誉军团勋章授勋引发股价波动：市场信号揭示政治圈层准入
title_secondary: Quand les distinctions de la Légion d’honneur française font fluctuer les cours boursiers : un signal du marché indiquant l’accès aux cercles politiques
authors: Stéphane Benveniste, Renaud Coulomb, Marc Sangnier
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Les distinctions d’État sont conçues comme des symboles de mérite et de reconnaissance publique. Mais elles peuvent également véhiculer des informations ayant une valeur économique. Cet article explore la valeur de marché de la Légion d’honneur. Lorsque des administrateurs de sociétés françaises cotées en bourse reçoivent cette distinction, le cours des actions de leur entreprise augmente. Cette réaction du marché concerne principalement les administrateurs qui, avant la remise de la distinction, n’avaient aucun lien scolaire observable publiquement avec des membres du gouvernement en place. Cette tendance suggère que les distinctions d’État peuvent fournir aux investisseurs de nouvelles informations sur l’accès potentiel d’un dirigeant aux décideurs politiques.
abstract_zh: 国家荣誉勋章被视为功绩与公众认可的象征，但它们也可能传递具有经济价值的信息。本文探讨了法国荣誉军团勋章的市场价值。当法国上市公司的董事获得这一荣誉时，其所在公司的股价会上涨。这种市场反应主要集中于那些在授勋前与现任政府成员之间不存在公开可观察的校友关系的董事。这一趋势表明，国家荣誉勋章能够为投资者提供关于企业高管接触政策制定者潜在渠道的新信息。

title: Bundling Trades In Over-The-Counter Markets
title_zh: 场外交易市场中的捆绑交易
title_primary: 场外交易市场中的捆绑交易
title_secondary: Bundling Trades In Over-The-Counter Markets
authors: Jason Allen, Milena Wittwer
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In the canonical view of over-the-counter markets, dealers intermediate single-asset trades one at a time. We study a complementary role: when investors trade several assets at once, dealers absorb the joint position into inventory, insuring against execution risk. Using data on the near-universe of Canadian fixed-income trades, we find that bundled transactions account for 20 percent of investor volume. We develop a simple model of why, when, where, and at what prices investors bundle, and use it to explain three patterns. Switches—a purchase paired with a sale—transact at a discount, while uni-directional bundles—all buys or sells—transact at a premium, because a switch’s legs hedge within the dealer’s book while a uni-directional bundle’s compound. Bundling rises with volatility, when insurance against execution risk is most valuable, and the two types sort asymmetrically across bilateral and electronic venues. Together, these patterns reveal a dimension of intermediation the single-asset view overlooks, and one likely to grow in importance.
abstract_zh: 在场外交易市场的经典视角中，交易商一次仅中介单一资产交易。我们研究了一个互补性角色：当投资者同时交易多种资产时，交易商将联合头寸纳入库存，以此对冲执行风险。利用加拿大固定收益市场近乎全量交易数据，我们发现捆绑交易占投资者交易量的20%。我们构建了一个简约模型，解释投资者为何、何时、何地以及以何种价格进行捆绑交易，并以此阐明三种模式。配对交易（买入与卖出组合）以折价成交，而单向捆绑（全买或全卖）则以溢价成交，原因在于配对交易的各腿在交易商账簿内对冲风险，而单向捆绑的各腿则叠加风险。当执行风险对冲价值最高时，捆绑交易随波动率上升而增加，且两类交易在双边与电子交易平台间呈现非对称分布。这些模式共同揭示了单一资产视角所忽视的中介维度，且该维度的重要性预计将持续增长。

title: Disentangling the Effects of the 2018–2019 Tariffs on a Globally Connected U.S. Manufacturing Sector
title_zh: 解析2018-2019年关税对全球关联的美国制造业的影响
title_primary: 解析2018-2019年关税对全球关联的美国制造业的影响
title_secondary: Disentangling the Effects of the 2018–2019 Tariffs on a Globally Connected U.S. Manufacturing Sector
authors: Aaron Flaaen, Justin Pierce
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper estimates the relationship between the U.S. tariff increases of 2018–2019 and outcomes in domestic manufacturing. Despite being intended to boost manufacturing activity, we find U.S. industries more exposed to tariff increases experience relative reductions in employment, as a small positive effect from import protection is offset by larger negative effects from rising input costs and retaliatory tariffs. Higher tariffs are also associated with relative increases in producer prices due to rising input costs. Last, we document broader labor market impacts, as counties more exposed to rising tariffs exhibit relative increases in unemployment and declines in labor force participation.
abstract_zh: 本文估算了2018-2019年美国关税上调与国内制造业产出之间的关系。尽管关税上调旨在促进制造业活动，但我们发现，受关税上调影响更大的美国行业反而经历了相对就业减少，这是因为进口保护带来的微弱正面效应被投入成本上升和报复性关税带来的更大负面效应所抵消。由于投入成本上升，更高的关税还与生产者价格相对上涨相关。最后，我们记录了更广泛的劳动力市场影响：受关税上调影响更大的县出现了失业率相对上升和劳动参与率下降的现象。

title: The Economic Impact of the USAID Shutdown
title_zh: 美国国际开发署关闭的经济影响
title_primary: 美国国际开发署关闭的经济影响
title_secondary: The Economic Impact of the USAID Shutdown
authors: Nicolini, Marcella, Sabatini, Fabio
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: On 28 January 2025 the second Trump administration issued a blanket stop-work order on the United States Agency for International Development (USAID), terminating the largest national bilateral aid programme worldwide. We use this natural experiment to estimate the impact of the aid cut on two outcomes in Africa: local economic activity, measured through nighttime light radiance around USAID project sites; and acute food insecurity, measured through the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) at the subnational level. First, the cessation of USAID activities produced a sharp and significant decline in nighttime light radiance within 500 m to 10 km of project sites, attenuating monotonically and undetectable at 25 km. Second, areas more exposed to USAID humanitarian assistance saw relative increases in population in IPC Phase 3 (Crisis) or worse and Phase 4 (Emergency), with effects building over the first post-shock year, amplified in higher-vulnerability regions and approximately fourteen times larger in less democratic countries. Third, both effects are driven by humanitarian-aid cuts; the nightlight effect is also driven by productive-sector cuts.
abstract_zh: 2025年1月28日，第二届特朗普政府发布全面停工令，叫停美国国际开发署（USAID）的所有工作，终止了全球规模最大的双边援助项目。我们利用这一自然实验，评估援助削减对非洲两项结果的影响：一是以USAID项目点周边夜间灯光亮度衡量的地方经济活动；二是以次国家级综合粮食安全阶段分类（IPC）衡量的严重粮食不安全状况。首先，USAID活动的停止导致项目点周边500米至10公里范围内夜间灯光亮度急剧且显著下降，该效应随距离单调衰减，至25公里处已无法检测。其次，在更依赖USAID人道主义援助的地区，处于IPC第三阶段（危机）或更糟阶段以及第四阶段（紧急）的人口比例相对上升，该效应在冲击后第一年内持续累积，在高脆弱性地区被放大，且在民主程度较低的国家中约高出十四倍。第三，上述两种效应均由人道主义援助削减驱动；夜间灯光效应还受到生产部门援助削减的影响。

title: Did the outbreak of COVID‐19 and individual exposure to it increase ingroup bias in the USA? An experimental investigation of interethnic trust
title_zh: COVID-19疫情爆发及个体暴露程度是否加剧了美国的内群体偏见？一项关于族裔间信任的实验研究
title_primary: COVID-19疫情爆发及个体暴露程度是否加剧了美国的内群体偏见？一项关于族裔间信任的实验研究
title_secondary: Did the outbreak of COVID‐19 and individual exposure to it increase ingroup bias in the USA? An experimental investigation of interethnic trust
authors: Gianluca Grimalda, Fabrice Murtin, David Pipke, Louis Putterman, Matthias Sutter
official: 官方在线 2026-06-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Pathogen‐stress and terror‐management theories predict that lethal epidemics heighten parochial cooperation. We test this prediction experimentally in two nationally representative US samples surveyed before and at the onset of the COVID‐19 pandemic. We compare trust and expected trustworthiness across the two waves in monetarily incentivized trust games involving non‐Hispanic Whites, African Americans and Hispanics. We find significant ingroup favouritism in both waves. However, the aggregate ingroup premium fell by about one‐half between waves. This decline was concentrated among left‐leaning and moderate respondents. While non‐Hispanic Whites tended to reduce their ingroup bias in expected trustworthiness, the opposite was found for African Americans. Respondents more exposed to COVID‐19 displayed higher intergroup trust, altruism and expected trustworthiness than others. These results contradict the hypothesis that lethal epidemics intensify parochialism, also suggesting that the response may be diversified across groups.
abstract_zh: 病原体应激与恐怖管理理论预测，致命性流行病会加剧群体内合作。我们通过两项具有全国代表性的美国样本（分别在COVID-19疫情爆发前后进行调查）对这一预测进行了实验检验。我们比较了涉及非西班牙裔白人、非洲裔美国人和西班牙裔的货币激励信任博弈中两轮调查的信任与预期可信度。研究发现两轮调查均存在显著的群体内偏袒现象。然而，群体内溢价的总量在两轮调查间下降了约一半，这一下降主要集中在左倾和温和派受访者中。非西班牙裔白人倾向于降低其在预期可信度方面的群体内偏见，而非洲裔美国人则呈现相反趋势。相较于其他受访者，更易接触COVID-19的受访者表现出更高的群体间信任、利他主义和预期可信度。这些结果与致命性流行病会加剧群体内偏见的假设相矛盾，同时表明不同群体的反应可能存在差异。

title: Is high-speed internet detrimental for early childhood development? Evidence from a countrywide program
title_zh: 高速互联网对幼儿早期发展有害吗？来自全国性项目的证据
title_primary: 高速互联网对幼儿早期发展有害吗？来自全国性项目的证据
title_secondary: Is high-speed internet detrimental for early childhood development? Evidence from a countrywide program
authors: Karina Colombo, Elisa Failache
official: 官方在线 September  · 来源：RSS
abstract: We estimate the effects of high-speed internet in early childhood development exploiting cross-cohort and geographic differences in the introduction of fiber-optic-to-the-home. Using variation in lifetime cumulative exposure to fiber optic and combining survey and administrative data, we estimate effects on cognitive and non-cognitive outcomes measured by validated screening tests. We show that an increase in 10 percentage points in lifetime exposure to fiber optic decreases development scores between 6% and 17% of a standard deviation in communication, problem solving and social skills. An analysis of heterogeneous effects shows that the negative impact is larger for children with more educated parents.

title: Unintended Environmental Consequences of Capital Goods Imports: Evidence From China
title_zh: 资本品进口的非预期环境后果：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 资本品进口的非预期环境后果：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Unintended Environmental Consequences of Capital Goods Imports: Evidence From China
authors: Angdi Lu, Jiang Zhang, Jie Li, Qiangyuan Chen, Jia Cao
official: 官方在线 2026-06-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the environmental consequences of capital goods imports, employing China's subsidy policy as a natural experiment. The policy, which provides reimbursement to firms for the cost of imported capital, has an unintended impact on the environmental outcomes of firms. We employ the difference‐in‐differences methodology to distinguish between firms highly expose to the policy as the treatment group and less exposed ones as the control group. The results indicate that the subsidy policy significantly reduces firms' total chemical oxygen demand emissions by 21.2% and their emission intensity by 21.8%, revealing notable unanticipated environmental benefits of the policy. The reduction in emissions is primarily attributable to improvements in the production process rather than post‐production abatement. State‐owned firms and firms with a higher proportion of skilled workers exhibit more pronounced reductions. Additionally, our findings suggest that the import of capital goods fosters green innovation, a crucial mechanism through which the subsidy policy exerts an influence on emission reductions. This study offers insights into the environmental consequences of trade policies and the combined effects of production and innovation strategies in response to non‐environmental incentives.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了资本品进口的环境后果，以中国的补贴政策作为自然实验。该政策为企业进口资本成本提供报销，却意外影响了企业的环境表现。我们采用双重差分法，将受政策影响较大的企业作为处理组，影响较小的企业作为对照组。结果表明，补贴政策显著降低了企业化学需氧量总排放量21.2%，排放强度下降21.8%，揭示了该政策显著且未预期的环境效益。排放减少主要归因于生产过程的改进，而非生产后的末端治理。国有企业及高技能工人比例较高的企业表现出更显著的减排效果。此外，我们的发现表明，资本品进口促进了绿色创新，这是补贴政策影响减排的关键机制。本研究为贸易政策的环境后果以及企业在非环境激励下生产与创新策略的联合效应提供了洞见。

title: Bridging the gap: how renewable energy development reduces urban-rural income inequality in China
title_zh: 缩小差距：可再生能源发展如何降低中国城乡收入不平等
title_primary: 缩小差距：可再生能源发展如何降低中国城乡收入不平等
title_secondary: Bridging the gap: how renewable energy development reduces urban-rural income inequality in China
authors: Jing-Yue Liu, Quan Lei, Yue-Jun Zhang
official: 官方在线 November 2 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Renewable energy development is central to climate change mitigation, but whether it also reduces urban–rural income inequality remains unclear. Using panel data for 271 Chinese prefecture-level cities from 2005 to 2019, we combine two-way fixed-effects models with an instrumental-variable strategy to estimate the effect of renewable energy development on the urban–rural income gap. The results show that renewable energy development significantly reduces urban–rural income inequality: a one-standard-deviation increase lowers the gap by about 11%, and this finding remains robust across multiple robustness checks. The effect is more evident in regions with richer solar resources, lower fossil energy dependence, and lower urbanization levels. Mechanism analyses further suggest that this effect operates by improving rural employment and enhancing educational accessibility in rural areas. We also find that the inequality-reducing effect is significantly strengthened in regions with more developed green finance, highlighting the enabling role of green finance in renewable expansion. These findings show that renewable energy development can generate both climate and equity gains, with important implications for coordinated urban–rural development. We therefore recommend prioritizing renewable projects in rural areas with strong resource endowments and lower urbanization levels, while strengthening green finance systems to support more inclusive development.

title: Socioeconomic status and gender gaps in educational outcomes across the life course: New distributional evidence from linked census-administrative data
title_zh: 社会经济地位与教育成果性别差异的生命历程变化：基于关联普查行政数据的新分布证据
title_primary: 社会经济地位与教育成果性别差异的生命历程变化：基于关联普查行政数据的新分布证据
title_secondary: Socioeconomic status and gender gaps in educational outcomes across the life course: New distributional evidence from linked census-administrative data
authors: Nguyen, Ha, Chapman, Bruce, Le, Huong, Royer, Heather, Dearden, Lorraine 等
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study uses whole-of-population linked census-administrative data to examine gender gaps in educational outcomes from early primary school through early adulthood in Australia and to assess the contribution of socioeconomic factors to these gaps either at the mean and along the distribution of educational outcomes. Leveraging the richness and large size of the linked data and employing some of the most rigorous empirical approaches in the literature, including mother and twin fixed-effects models, we find that females outperform males as early as ages 5–6 across multiple developmental domains, and that this advantage persists through university. The gender gap in favour of females is larger among lower-performing students. We also find that boys benefit more than girls from growing up in more advantaged families, particularly among academically lower-performing boys. However, this advantage is observed only for outcomes measured in the early years of primary school. By contrast, for outcomes measured at the tertiary level, most indicators of socioeconomic advantage confer stronger benefits to females, especially among individuals at the lower end of the educational attainment distribution. Finally, having ruled out gender differences in birth weight—which favour males—we identify gender differences across siblings in school sector choice and early childhood health conditions, both favouring females, as potential mechanisms underlying these patterns.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用全人口关联普查与行政数据，考察澳大利亚从小学早期至成年早期的教育成果性别差距，并评估社会经济因素在均值及教育成果分布上对这些差距的贡献。借助关联数据的丰富性与大规模特征，并采用文献中最严谨的实证方法（包括母亲固定效应模型和双胞胎固定效应模型），我们发现：早在5-6岁阶段，女性在多个发展领域已优于男性，且这一优势持续至大学阶段。女性优势的性别差距在学业表现较低的学生中更为显著。同时，成长于更优越家庭环境的男孩比女孩获益更多，尤其体现在学业表现较低的男孩群体中——但这一优势仅存在于小学早期阶段的教育成果指标。相比之下，在高等教育阶段，大多数社会经济优势指标对女性更有利，尤其对教育成就分布底端的个体而言。最后，在排除出生体重（男性占优）的性别差异后，我们识别出兄弟姐妹间在学校类型选择及儿童早期健康状况上的性别差异（两者均有利于女性），这些差异构成了上述模式的潜在机制。

title: Comment on ‘Asset Bubbles and Overlapping Generations’ by Jean Tirole
title_zh: 评让·梯若尔《资产泡沫与世代交叠》
title_primary: 评让·梯若尔《资产泡沫与世代交叠》
title_secondary: Comment on ‘Asset Bubbles and Overlapping Generations’ by Jean Tirole
authors: Ngoc‐Sang Pham, Alexis Akira Toda
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Tirole (1985) studied an overlapping generations model with capital accumulation and showed that the emergence of asset bubbles solves the capital over‐accumulation problem. His Proposition 1(c) claims that if the dividend growth rate is above the bubbleless interest rate (the steady‐state interest rate in the economy without the asset) but below the population growth rate, then bubbles are necessary in the sense that there exists no bubbleless equilibrium but there exists a unique bubbly equilibrium. We show that this result (as stated) is incorrect by presenting an example economy that satisfies all assumptions of Proposition 1(c) but its unique equilibrium is bubbleless. We also restore Proposition 1(c) under the additional assumptions that initial capital is sufficiently large and dividends are sufficiently small. We show through examples that these conditions are essential.
abstract_zh: Tirole（1985）研究了一个包含资本积累的代际交叠模型，并指出资产泡沫的出现解决了资本过度积累问题。其命题1(c)声称，若股息增长率高于无泡沫利率（即无资产经济中的稳态利率）但低于人口增长率，则泡沫是必要的，即不存在无泡沫均衡，但存在唯一的有泡沫均衡。我们通过构造一个满足命题1(c)所有假设但唯一均衡为无泡沫的示例经济体，证明了该结果（如所述）是不正确的。我们还在额外假设初始资本足够大且股息足够小的条件下，恢复了命题1(c)。我们通过示例表明，这些条件是必不可少的。

title: Work Hours Mismatch
title_zh: 工时错配
title_primary: 工时错配
title_secondary: Work Hours Mismatch
authors: Marta Lachowska, Alexandre Mas, Raffaele Saggio, Stephen A. Woodbury
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We apply a revealed preference approach to administrative data from Washington to show that constraints on work hours are widespread: Workers have limited discretion over hours at a given employer, and there is substantial mismatch of workers who prefer long hours to employers that provide short hours. Voluntary job transitions imply a ratio of the marginal rate of substitution of earnings for hours to the wage rate of 0.5–0.6 for prime‐age workers. The average absolute deviation between observed and optimal hours is about 15%, and low‐wage workers face particularly acute constraints on hours. On average, observed hours tend to be less than preferred levels, and workers would require a 12% higher wage with their current employer to be as well off as with an employer offering ideal hours. These findings suggest that hour constraints are an equilibrium feature of the labor market because long‐hour jobs are costly to employers.

title: Intellectual property protection lost and competition: An examination using large language models
title_zh: 知识产权保护缺失与竞争：基于大语言模型的检验
title_primary: 知识产权保护缺失与竞争：基于大语言模型的检验
title_secondary: Intellectual property protection lost and competition: An examination using large language models
authors: Utku U. Acikalin, Tolga Caskurlu, Gerard Hoberg, Gordon M. Phillips
official: 官方在线 August 202 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine the impact of lost intellectual property protection on innovation, competition, firm performance, and valuation. We consider firms whose ability to protect intellectual property (IP) using patents is weakened following a major Supreme Court decision. We use large language models (LLM) to identify firms’ patent portfolios’ exposure to this decision and find an unequal impact. Large firms gain and small firms lose. Large impacted firms benefit as their sales growth increases and their exposure to lawsuits decreases. Small impacted firms lose as they face increased competition, product-market encroachment, and lower profits and valuations. They increase R&D and nondisclosure agreements.

title: Dynamic order dispersion and volatility persistence in a simple limit order book model
title_zh: 简单限价订单簿模型中的动态订单分散与波动持续性
title_primary: 简单限价订单簿模型中的动态订单分散与波动持续性
title_secondary: Dynamic order dispersion and volatility persistence in a simple limit order book model
authors: Andrew Hawley, Blake LeBaron, Mark Paddrik, Nathan Palmer
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This preliminary paper extends the dynamics of a basic stylized limit order book model introduced in Chiarella & Iori (2002). The original model is capable of generating some key market microstructure features, but it cannot recreate longer range persistence in volatility. We explore a very simple and intuitive addition to the stylized, near zero intelligence behavior of traders that is capable of delivering persistent volatility. We also show that this strategy depends critically on certain key features in the dynamics of supply and demand for liquidity and depth in the limit order book. We believe this is fundamental to understanding both the dynamics of volatility in financial time series, along with variations in liquidity in financial markets. We contribute a parsimonious agent-based model to the literature that may be used as a test bed or sandbox for developing agents with more complex behavior.
abstract_zh: 这篇初步论文扩展了Chiarella与Iori（2002）提出的基础简化限价订单簿模型的动态特性。原始模型能够生成一些关键的市场微观结构特征，但无法重现波动率中的长期持续性。我们探索了一种对交易者简化、近乎零智能行为的简单直观补充，该补充能够产生持续性的波动率。我们还表明，这一策略关键依赖于限价订单簿中流动性与深度供需动态的某些核心特征。我们认为，这对于理解金融时间序列中波动率的动态以及金融市场流动性的变化至关重要。我们为文献贡献了一个简约的基于代理的模型，可作为开发具有更复杂行为代理的测试平台或沙盒。

title: Credit rationing in unsecured debt markets
title_zh: 无担保债务市场中的信贷配给
title_primary: 无担保债务市场中的信贷配给
title_secondary: Credit rationing in unsecured debt markets
authors: V. Filipe Martins-da-Rocha, Toàn Phan, Yiannis Vailakis
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We revisit the welfare properties of competitive credit markets with endogenousdebt limits that arise from limited commitment. We introduce a novel concept ofconstrained efficiency to encompass economies where market interest rates influencedefault values and participation constraints. We explore this concept through a baselineeconomy featuring heterogeneous agents with cyclical endowments. The analysis showsthat the efficiency of market equilibria and welfare outcomes are sensitive to the natureof default punishments. It suggests that laissez-faire debt limits, while supportiveof risk-sharing, might not always optimize welfare. The study illustrates how creditrationing—tightening future debt limits—can enhance current risk-sharing and overallwelfare. This occurs because such interventions influence market interest rates andthe default option’s value, thereby affecting agents’ present consumption and savingchoices, and enabling a more efficient allocation of resources.

title: Climate change and perennial crop production: Evidence of yield impact and adaptation in California
title_zh: 气候变化与多年生作物生产：加州产量影响与适应的证据
title_primary: 气候变化与多年生作物生产：加州产量影响与适应的证据
title_secondary: Climate change and perennial crop production: Evidence of yield impact and adaptation in California
authors: Yuanyuan Wen, Wei Zhang, Julian M. Alston
official: 官方在线 2026-03-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Perennial crops are economically important. They contribute to food security, providing essential nutrients that are often lacking in annual crops, and provide additional environmental benefits compared with annual crops. Despite their importance, empirical research on the impacts of climate change and adaptation on perennial crops remains limited. We model the phenological characteristics of major perennial crops in California and take adaptation into consideration to estimate the effects of temperature and precipitation on yields in both the short run and long run. Our findings indicate that weather impacts vary across the four phenological phases—dormancy, bloom, fruit development, and fruit maturity. Specifically, warming during the dormancy phase reduces walnut yields and warming during the bloom phase reduces almond yields in both the short‐run and long‐run. These long‐run negative impacts suggest that adaptation has not offset the adverse effects of winter warming on these crops. On the other hand, warming in the fruit maturity phase positively affects almond yields, especially in the long run, suggesting that adaptation has taken advantage of rising temperatures to increase almond yields. Our findings provide valuable insights for targeted adaptation strategies to enhance the resilience of perennial crop production in the face of climate change.
